title: GFG Coding Contest
description: Compete in a GeeksforGeeks-powered coding contest designed to test your coding and logical reasoning abilities with problems covering data structures, algorithms, and competitive programming.
tagline: A skill-based competitive event to enhance problem-solving and programming skills.
longDescription: As part of EPOCH, the Coding Contest powered by GeeksforGeeks is a skill-based competitive event designed to test participants' coding and logical reasoning abilities. The contest will consist of a set of programming problems of varying difficulty levels, covering coding, data structures, algorithms, and logical reasoning. Participants will compete individually within a fixed time limit, solving problems using their preferred programming languages. The contest will follow standard competitive programming guidelines with live scoring and rankings. GeeksforGeeks will provide high-quality problem sets and a structured contest environment, ensuring a fair and challenging experience for all participants. This event aims to create a healthy competitive spirit while helping students sharpen their coding skills and prepare for real-world technical challenges.
highlights: Apply programming knowledge to solve real-time coding challenges
Improve problem-solving, analytical, and logical thinking skills
Gain exposure to competitive programming patterns and techniques
Learn the importance of time management and code optimization
Build confidence to participate in future coding contests and hackathons
Strengthen foundation in data structures and algorithms
prizes: Participation certificates for all. Top 3 winners receive GeeksforGeeks merchandise.

title: Open Source Contribution Workshop
description: Learn how to contribute to open source projects on GitHub and become part of the global developer community through hands-on collaboration.
tagline: Start your open source journey and collaborate with developers worldwide.
longDescription: This workshop is designed to introduce students to GitHub and its role in modern software development, with a special focus on Open Source Contribution. Through practical demonstrations and real-world examples, participants will learn how developers use GitHub to collaborate, manage code, and contribute to open source projects. The session provides hands-on exposure to essential tools used in the software industry and guides students on making their first contributions to real-world projects.
highlights: Understand the fundamentals of GitHub and version control
Learn how to find and contribute to open source projects
Gain insight into collaboration and code review processes
Understand real-world developer workflows using GitHub
Improve collaboration and project management skills
Make your first open source contribution during the workshop

title: DSA for Tech Interviews
description: Master core data structures and algorithms concepts commonly tested in technical interviews and learn how to approach interview-level problems effectively.
tagline: Build strong problem-solving skills for placement and internship interviews.
longDescription: This workshop focuses on introducing core DSA concepts commonly tested in technical interviews. Through explanations, examples, and problem-solving sessions, students will learn how to analyze problems and apply the right data structures and algorithms. The session emphasizes practical learning with an interview-oriented approach, helping participants gain confidence in tackling coding questions asked by top companies.
highlights: Understand the role of DSA in technical interviews
Learn key data structures and algorithmic concepts
Develop effective problem-solving and analytical skills
Gain exposure to interview-style coding questions
Improve confidence in approaching coding interviews
Learn patterns and approaches used by successful candidates

title: Gaming Tournament
description: Compete in popular multiplayer games in a thrilling virtual environment, showcasing your strategy, teamwork, and gaming skills.
tagline: High-energy competitive gaming for all skill levels.
longDescription: As part of EPOCH, the online gaming tournament offers students the chance to compete in popular multiplayer games in a thrilling virtual environment. Participants will battle it out in teams or individually, depending on the game format, with rounds designed to test reflexes, strategy, teamwork, and adaptability. A structured set of rounds, rules, and scoring will guide the event, while live commentary or streaming may enhance the experience for viewers. This event is open to casual gamers as well as seasoned players, making it a fun-filled and high-energy segment of the tech fest.
highlights: Develop strategic thinking and quick decision-making skills
Enhance teamwork, communication, and coordination
Learn to perform under pressure and adapt to fast-changing situations
Experience healthy competition and improve sportsmanship
Gain exposure to e-sports style formats and competitive gaming
Build confidence and discover strengths in strategy and collaboration

title: GitHub Pages Workshop
description: Learn how to create and deploy beautiful websites for free using GitHub Pages, perfect for portfolios, project documentation, and personal blogs.
tagline: Build and host your portfolio or project site in minutes with GitHub Pages.
longDescription: As part of EPOCH, the GitHub Pages workshop is an interactive, hands-on session where participants will learn how to create and deploy websites using GitHub Pages. The workshop will begin with an introduction to static site generation and how GitHub Pages simplifies web hosting. Students will then be guided through live demonstrations showing how to set up repositories, configure GitHub Pages, choose themes, and deploy their sites. Participants will actively create their own portfolio or project websites, learning to customize designs and publish content. This workshop bridges the gap between having a project and showcasing it professionally to the world.
highlights: Understand GitHub Pages and static site hosting
Learn how to set up and configure a GitHub Pages site
Create a professional portfolio or project documentation site
Explore themes, custom domains, and site customization
Deploy and publish your site live on the internet
Build confidence in showcasing projects to potential employers
Gain practical skills for personal branding and online presence
